features.name: Abjuration Savant
features.desc: You copy Abjuration spells into your spellbook in half the time and for half the gold.

features.name: Arcane Ward
features.desc: When you cast an Abjuration spell of level 1 or higher, you create a magical ward with a Hit Point pool = 2 × Wizard level + Int modifier that absorbs damage dealt to you.

features.name: Projected Ward
features.desc: As a Reaction, you use your Arcane Ward to absorb damage dealt to a creature within 30 feet.

features.name: Improved Abjuration
features.desc: You add your Proficiency Bonus to the ability checks you make for Counterspell and Dispel Magic.

features.name: Spell Resistance
features.desc: Advantage on saving throws against spells and Resistance to their damage.
